verdict.rationale: Neon documents a Management API reference with per-endpoint pages and an LLM-addressed endpoint index. A live, machine-readable OpenAPI spec was confirmed by probe and is linked for validation and codegen. Nothing in the pack shows the reference is interactive (e.g., a try-it console) or ships runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable or executable request examples, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.
